hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was switched from off to on at 2026-09-14T00:07:00Z (a ramp: 97 off / 103 on in that minute, fully on from 00:08). The enabled code path divides by zero when computing monthly spend, producing ZeroDivisionError on account page requests and driving the error rate from ~0.01 to ~0.30-0.36.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
error_rate jumps from 0.0 at 00:06 to 0.15 at 00:07 and 0.295 at 00:08, staying ~0.30-0.36
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-06T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-14T00:13:00Z: (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: a pre-existing upstream payment-authorization fault worsened. UpstreamTimeout errors on account pages appeared at 00:03-00:05 before the flag flip, so an upstream dependency was already degrading; however the sustained error burst is a different error class (ZeroDivisionError) and coincides with the flag, so this is at most a contributing background condition.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out
WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 4% over the last minute
